Name: Clinical Psychology Studying TV Channel
Author: CozyPsychologist
Description:
[center][size=5][b]EPPP Study Channel[/b][/size]
[i]A daily psychology quiz on your Stardew Valley TV for the [/i][/center]
[center][u][b]Examination for Professional Practice in Psychology (EPPP) [/b][/u][/center]

[size=4][b]Overview[/b][/size]

Ever wanted your cozy farming life to double as exam prep? The EPPP Study Channel adds a custom TV channel that airs a new clinical psychology question every day for one in-game year — 112 unique questions.

Answer correctly and earn [b]500g[/b]. Get it wrong and the correct answer is shown so you actually learn something. One gold reward per day, so no cheesing it.

Whether you're a psychology enthusiast who just likes the content, or a trainee actually grinding toward licensure, there's something here for you.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]112 unique questions[/b] — one for every day for a full in-game year[/*]
[*][b]4 answer choices[/b] per question with carefully constructed distractors[/*]
[*][b]Correct answer revealed[/b] on wrong answers — no guessing and walking away empty-handed[/*]
[*][b]500g daily reward[/b] for correct answers, gated per day so it can't be farmed[/*]
[*][b]Full domain coverage[/b] across all major EPPP content areas[/*]
[*]Seamlessly integrated into the vanilla TV channel menu[/*]
[/list]
[b]***Disclaimer: This mod is a study supplement made for fun because I am actively studying for this exam — it is not affiliated with the ASPPB, does not guarantee exam outcomes, and should not replace dedicated EPPP prep resources. Questions were not taken from any dedicated EPPP prep resource.****[/b]


[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/BROADCASTAPI_ID]BroadcastAPI[/url][b](required)[/b]



[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Install SMAPI, Content Patcher, and BroadcastAPI[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip[/*]
[*]Drop the [font=Courier New][CP] EPPPChannel[/font] folder into your [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] directory[/*]
[*]Launch the game — the channel will appear in any TV's channel menu[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]Compatible with multiplayer (each player sees the channel; gold reward is per-player)[/*]
[*]No known conflicts with other mods[/*]
[/list]
